'''''The Wheel Weaves''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[The Great Hunt/Chapter 34|thirty-forth chapter]] of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* The [[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 40|fortieth chapter]] of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
